verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents an official `lms` CLI. Its docs page lists commands for terminal chat (`lms chat`), model download (`lms get`), loading models with GPU and context-length flags (`lms load`), and starting and stopping the server (`lms server start/stop`). Together with the headless llmster daemon, this clearly delivers a first-party CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the `lms` CLI specifically, and evidence of AI/agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote:
lms server start
lms server stop
